shape: 3-portal split arena (S + W + E gates) with west bridge + east clique
description: Three-portal arena. q3d634 (-14.18, -2.61) is a 3-way west-side hub joining spawn_west + spawn_south + iihsqx (center-NW bridge). The south arm continues iihsqx → 847i5j → s6uuf1 (SW pocket chain). d4m28c bridges iihsqx to 5jwl0u (4-way south hub: grb3mx, z20krf, 98d296). The EAST CLIQUE: 98d296 → dxglkt (east entry, 3-way) → 68ahcv → r7qbex → xgayf3 (NE pocket chain).

portals.south: spawn_south at (-13.36, 9.89) — gate on the south (high-Z) side, west column
portals.east: spawn_east at (22.97, 5.45) — gate on the east (high-X) side
portals.west: spawn_west at (-23.39, -2.77) — gate on the west (low-X) side

anchors.description: west 3-way hub - joins S + W gates (matches q3d634)
center-N bridge - links c_nw to south hub (matches d4m28c)

traversalNotes: Direct W→S: spawn_west → w_hub → spawn_south. 2 hops (w_hub directly connects both gates).
Direct W→E: spawn_west → w_hub → c_nw → c_n → s_hub → se_anchor → east_inner → spawn_east. 7 hops.
Direct S→E: spawn_south → w_hub → c_nw → c_n → s_hub → se_anchor → east_inner → spawn_east. 7 hops.
STRICT-BACKBONE: single chain from west half to east half through c_nw → c_n → s_hub. No alternate routes.
SW pocket chain (sw_step → sw_pocket) is a 2-hop dead-end off c_nw.
N pocket chain (ne_step → n_anchor → n_pocket) is a 3-hop NE dead-end off east_inner.
s_pocket and se_pocket are 1-degree dead-ends off s_hub.
